run_export_all: run the script to export depth images, color images, poses, and intrinsics from a sens file
run_export_depth_only: run the script with --export_depth_images to export only depth images from a sens file
run_export_color_only: run the script with --export_color_images to export only color images from a sens file
run_export_poses_only: run the script with --export_poses to export only camera poses from a sens file
run_export_intrinsics_only: run the script with --export_intrinsics to export only camera intrinsics from a sens file
